answer: Reputation decays 4% per epoch for an idle identity, and a failed audit cuts the score 60%. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, so a replayed answer hashes stale and pays 0. An attacker running 100 identities must keep all 100 active for 25 epochs to stay above threshold, and every false claim costs 60% that rebuilds only through new work. A replayed answer is an echo that pays nothing, the ember of a rebuilt score cools on the next failed audit, and a fresh nonce is the only whisper the ledger hears.
